name: Aota Seiji
source:
A material witness for a homicide investigation. He escaped from custody and stole a gun and uniform.
He's nervous and short-tempered, and has an unusual disgust for sex between men. He also suffers from [url=https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Taijin_kyofusho]social phobia[/url].
translation:
A material witness for a homicide investigation. He escaped from custody and stole a gun and uniform.
He's nervous and short-tempered, and has an unusual disgust for sex between men. He also suffers from [url=https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Taijin_kyofusho]social phobia[/url].
